storySection.title: More than a guesthouse, a family.
storySection.paragraph1: For generations, our family has lived to the rhythm of the sun and the Saharan sand. Maison Étoile Du Désert was not built to be a hotel, but as an extension of our own home.
storySection.paragraph2: We opened our doors to travelers from around the world with a single promise: to let you experience true Berber hospitality. Here, time slows down. You are not just a customer, you are our guest.

testimonialsSection.title: What our travelers say about us
testimonialsSection.subtitle: The excellence of our welcome is recognized internationally.

contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.subtitle: A question about your future stay? A special request? Our team is at your disposal to help you prepare for your trip to the desert.
contactPage.whatsappMessage: Hello Maison Étoile Du Désert, I would like to get some information to organize my visit.
contactPage.step1Text: Take the national road towards Tiznit (100 km), branch off towards Bouizakarne (50 km), then take the road to Guelmim (50 km).
contactPage.step2Text: Two options: cross the city from north to south following the 'Tata / Assa' signs, or avoid the center by taking the Eastern bypass.
contactPage.step3Text: 3 km after leaving Guelmim (Marjane roundabout), turn right towards Asrir. Follow the clearly visible signs to the Tighmert oasis.
contactPage.step4Text: You can park your vehicle right in front of the house. If you get lost, give us a call!
